text:
Predicates:
Student(x) ::: x is a student.
WorksInLibrary(x) ::: x works in the library.
PartTimeJob(x) ::: x has a part-time job offered by the university.
FromComputerScience(x) ::: x is from the computer science department.
TakingCourse(x, y) ::: x is taking course y.
Professor(x, y) ::: x is a professor y teaches.
Lab(x) ::: x works in the lab.
James ::: the individual James.

Premises:
¬∃x (Student(x) ∧ WorksInLibrary(x) ∧ FromComputerScience(x)) ::: None of the students who currently work in the library are from the computer science department.
∀x (Student(x) ∧ PartTimeJob(x) ∧ OfferedByUniversity(x)) → WorksInLibrary(x) ::: All students with part-time jobs offered by the university currently work in the library.
∀x (Student(x) ∧ TakingCourse(x, database)) → FromComputerScience(x) ::: All students taking the database course are from the computer science department.
∀x (Student(x) ∧ TakingClassWith(x, ProfessorDavid)) → TakingCourse(x, database) ::: All students taking a class with Professor David are taking the database course.
∀x (Student(x) ∧ WorkingInLab(x)) → TakingClassWith(x, ProfessorDavid) ::: All students working in the lab are taking a class with Professor David.
James ::: James.
¬(WorksInLab(James) ∨ PartTimeJob(James)) ::: James doesn't work in the lab or have a part-time job offered by the university.

Conclusion:
Does James take the database course?
